==== INTERCONNECT LAYER -- MASTER LOG ====
NUM_BEATS=64 per channel, DATA_WIDTH=512 (64 bytes/beat), aclk=pcie_clk=1ns period.
Write/read counts are gated on the FIFO's own wr_ptr_bin/rd_ptr_bin actually changing,
not on the combinational write-enable signal, so these counts are trustworthy as-is.
